chunks: How keenly would they hear and see when they come before Us then, even though today the evil-doers are lost in palpable error.

key_terms.أَبْصِرْ: Make them see / They will see
key_terms.أَسْمِعْ: Make them hear / They will hear

ai.seo_question: What is the condition of the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Maryam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine reckoning, where the disbelievers' heightened sensory perception on the Day of Judgment serves as a painful confirmation of the truth they denied in the world. It highlights the transition from 'clear error' (dalal mubin) to the stark reality of accountability, emphasizing that their current misguidance will not excuse their future sensory experience of the Hereafter.
